rows.grounds: fused form balavate + namaḥ; kept as single token

items.question: What divine attributes are affirmed through repeated obeisance to these epithets?
premises: analāya identifies the honored principle as fire
balavatenamaḥ conjoins power with obeisance in a fused salutation
upaśāntāya attributes a calmed state to the honored principle
items.inference: The sequence affirms a deity characterized by fire, power, and calmness through ritual salutation.
uncertainties: The exact referent of these epithets depends on the surrounding liturgical context.
items.plain_english: Obeisance to the one who is fire. Obeisance to the powerful one. Obeisance to the calmed one.
